description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Notify the Corrected Version for the Gaz.Ex.No. 2075/31 of 14.06.2018, being Printing mistalces, Notify the Special Commodity Levy on Maldive fish, Turmeric etc.
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition and amendment of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory orders specifying tax rates on various commodities, which falls under the category of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it deals with regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements rather than government personnel/structure, land, commercial, elections, public service, judicial, or miscellaneous matters.
